caveat: This is a projection of the published Planck f_NL^local = -0.9 ± 5.1 through our computed template cosine (0.97). It is NOT a new bispectrum measurement from Planck maps. The result confirms consistency but does not constitute independent evidence.
honest_summary: The bounce prediction sits inside the broad Planck error bar. This is expected and not surprising given sigma ~ 5.
